title: March Madness Team Index
description: Lightweight per-season team index used by the website for search, routing, filters, and bracket label resolution.

season.description: Tournament season represented by the index payload.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp showing when this artifact was generated.

teams.description: Minimal website-facing team records for one season.

teamIndexEntry.title: Team Index Entry
teamIndexEntry.description: A single team-season record used for autocomplete, routing, bracket placement, and filter chips.

name.description: Full team name for display and search.

short_name.description: Compact display name used when bracket nodes need shorter labels.

conference.description: Conference identifier for filtering and context displays.

seed.description: Tournament seed if the team made the field; null otherwise.

region.description: Bracket region label for tournament teams.

slot.description: Seed slot or play-in slot identifier used by the bracket definition.

tournament_team.description: Whether the team is in the NCAA tournament field for this season.

team_page_path.description: Relative artifact path to the rich Team Insights payload for this team-season.
